recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Chocolate Mousse with Chocolate Shell
steps: Blend the cottage cheese, cocoa and maple syrup until completely smooth.
Spoon into 4 small ramekins or glasses.
Melt the chocolate chips with the coconut oil in short microwave bursts and pour a layer over each mousse.
Sprinkle with flaky salt and chill at least 2 hours until the chocolate sets.
recipes.notes: Ingredients and calories are the creator's; the page has no step-by-step method, so the steps are my reading of it (blend, top with melted chocolate, chill), and protein, carbs and fat are my estimate.
